description:
The plot illustrates the relationship between the number of iterations and vocabulary size for four different languages. The x-axis is labeled "Number of Iterations" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 500, with tick labels at intervals of 100. The y-axis is labeled "Vocabulary Size" and has a linear scale ranging from 0 to 5000, with tick labels at intervals of 1000. 

The blue line represents "Spanish" and is a solid line. Starting at approximately 500 at 0 iterations, it increases to approximately 3200 at 500 iterations, with a generally steady upward trend. The orange line represents "Korean" and is a solid line. It begins at approximately 400 at 0 iterations and rises to approximately 2800 at 500 iterations, also with a generally steady upward trend. The green line represents "Japanese" and is a solid line. It starts at approximately 300 at 0 iterations and increases to approximately 2500 at 500 iterations, exhibiting a similar steady upward trend.  A gray line is also present, starting at approximately 0 at 0 iterations and increasing linearly to approximately 5000 at 500 iterations.
